title: Clo At Febratex In Brazil 🇧🇷
description:
Thanks to everyone that came out to this year's Febratex! It was amazing to feel your energy & excitement around digital fashion & 3D during our talks & live demos. Check out our best moments from Blumenau 🇧🇷

#febratex2024

transcript: I came to know Clou3D better because I'm looking for innovation in the segment, I'm also looking for innovation to present the collections. Clou3D, I believe, is a super important tool for us to improve this process, as well as artificial intelligence, which I already use in my work. I think technology really came to open a range and improve our segment. I didn't know we could bring this to the text, I thought technology was still very limited in the machinery part, in the systems part, but the text will grow a lot with you, thank God. You are on the market. With the presentation I saw here today, what I found most interesting is that you can make this piece, so you can see it on the mannequin first, before planning. With that, I can check on fabric, colors, so my client can see it ready, because we have this skill, but the client doesn't. Clou3D is an integral part of the industry, and it is what gave Clou3D its name. Since it was created, it has been Она PORTAGAL. We have been implementing Clou3D for two years, we were the first teaching institute in Brazil to have software, and now the market is looking for this competence, and there are few professionals who know how to use 3D software, in the fashion market. From last Thursday onwards, the development here in Rio Grande do Sul is really great, and we are very impressed. I always think that when we talk about ready-made practices, what are the first things that we'll learn just in the next few days? The evolution of tools and new things is very big here, so it's fascinating. We really want to take, not only talk, but dominate with the property, all the efficiency that this resource, that this software gives us, provides us.
markdown_content: ## Introduction to Clou3D and Its Role in Fashion Innovation This section introduces Clou3D as an innovative tool in the fashion industry, emphasizing its integration with artificial intelligence and its potential to transform product presentation and collection development. It highlights the expanding role of technology beyond machinery and systems, particularly in textile design and visualization. Clou3D is recognized as a crucial technological advancement for improving the fashion design and production process. It allows designers to visualize garments on mannequins before physical creation, enabling evaluation of fabric, color, and fit early in the design phase. This capability bridges the gap between designers’ skills and clients' understanding, enhancing communication and customer experience. The software’s influence extends to the textile segment, where it supports innovation and efficiency. The introduction of Clou3D in Brazil marks a significant step in modernizing the industry, particularly as artificial intelligence tools are increasingly incorporated into fashion workflows. ## Implementation and Market Adoption of Clou3D in Brazil This section covers the adoption and educational integration of Clou3D within Brazil’s fashion industry, focusing on its role in professional training and regional development. Brazil’s first teaching institute to adopt Clou3D has been utilizing the software for two years, positioning itself as a pioneer in 3D fashion technology education. This early adoption reflects a growing demand in the market for professionals skilled in 3D software, which remains a scarce expertise in the Brazilian fashion sector. The development and adoption of Clou3D in the Rio Grande do Sul region have accelerated since last Thursday, demonstrating rapid regional growth and interest. The software’s capabilities are seen as essential for mastering efficiency and effectiveness in ready-made garment production and presentation. Industry professionals express strong enthusiasm about not only discussing but fully mastering Clou3D’s functionalities to leverage the software's full potential in improving operational workflows and competitive advantage.
